description:
Zero-dependency implementation of the German banking industry's account number
        check digit methods ("Prüfzifferberechnungsmethoden in der deutschen Kreditwirtschaft"),
        as catalogued by the Deutsche Bundesbank. Validates whether a Kontonummer is
        structurally consistent for a given method, independently of any IBAN or BLZ
        master-data lookup. Deliberately standalone: does not depend on iban-commons,
        so it can be used on its own by callers that only have a BLZ and Kontonummer
        (e.g. legacy domestic payment processing) and have obtained the applicable
        method number from elsewhere (such as a BLZ master-data module).
